text:
Munster’s median asking rent sits at 13.92 €/m², up 5.4 % year‑on‑year and 30.9 % over the last five years, placing the city 11th among the 37 most expensive German markets. The 60 m² benchmark rent is 835 € per month, while the asking premium over existing rents is 60 %, reflecting strong upward momentum.

The market remains tight, with a vacancy rate of 1.1 % and properties staying on the market for just 21 days; 36 % are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents is 17.2 %, and the median asking rent range spans 11.82 €/m² (p25) to 16.22 €/m² (p75), underscoring limited affordability.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent at 14.54 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 14.03 €/m² and 14.93 €/m², a 4.5 % increase.
